text:
maria: backup-bot alerted on several failed restores: "decrypt failed: missing key metadata" for some archived DB snapshots uploaded 2026-03-19..21.
backup-bot: ALERT 1740023462 - 6 restores failed in last 30m. uploader v2.1.0.
aj: is this KMS propagation or uploader change?
samir: root cause: multipart uploader fork in canary strips headers with prefix 'x-encrypt-' during compose; CMK ID lived in x-encrypt-cmk.
maria: which tenants affected?
leo: scan shows ~420 multipart objects (>5GB) missing x-encrypt-cmk between 2026-03-19 00:00 and 2026-03-21 08:00. mostly customer backups.
aj: how did you verify?
leo: ran `gsutil stat` and `aws s3api head-object` checks; metadata header absent.
nancy: any KMS audit entries? decrypt attempts?
samir: none. restore aborts early when metadata missing, so no KMS calls.
maria: short-term mitigation ideas?
aj: auto-fallback to tenant-default CMK is risky and might break key-scoping policies. need security/legal sign-off.
nancy: don't auto-fallback. enable manual restore path where ops provides CMK after tenant verification; every manual action requires an audit log entry and ephemeral grant id.
leo: engineering fix: revert uploader fork to upstream v2.0.7 which preserves metadata. canary in ~1h, prod after smoke. opening PR now.
samir: repair options: reupload from originals (preserves metadata) or metadata-replace via compose (GCS supports but has edge cases). reupload safer but costs bandwidth.
leo: estimate ~420 objects * ~12GB avg = ~5TB. can reupload via bucket-to-bucket copies with throttles over 24-48h. I'll produce a manifest CSV with affected object ids. pushing to s3://redwood-incident-artifacts/INC-2026-REL/manifest.csv
maria: create migration ticket and customer impact matrix. Samir/Nancy draft customer communications and verification checklist. include proof-of-possession steps.
nancy: add audit requirement: manual restores logged in encryptops channel with operator ephemeral grant id.
eng-oncall-bot: note created: #INC-2026-249 assigned to leo. severity P2.
leo: PR: https://github.com/redwood/backup-agent/pull/1287 (revert uploader fork). kicking tests.
maria: timeline: canary revert (leo) 1h, smoke tests 3h, prod rollout 6h, migration ticket 2h, ops comms 2h.
aj: forensics: snapshot current objects and manifest before any repair for evidence.
leo: will produce CSV manifest.
maria: pilot reupload for 2 tenants after prod revert to verify KMS audit entries. no auto-repair until pilot success.
samir: long-term: CI test that composes multipart uploads verifies metadata preserved; add deploy gate for uploader lib changes.
leo: adding tests to PR.
nancy: update runbook "restore when CMK header missing" with legal checks and key ownership verification.
maria: any objections?
aj: none :thumbsup:
eng-oncall-bot: canary deployed 1740024868 to canary cluster-3. basic smoke passed.
leo: found a GCS compose edge-case returning 412 on metadata replace for one object; will fall back to reupload for that one.
samir: sharing comm drafts in #encryptops-comms and cc legal.
maria: convert to postmortem if >1 tenant impacted or compliance flags. closing loop later today. :lock:
